messages.body_plain:
Tim,

 Unfortunately, we haven't coded up the multi-level model for our package.  In principle, you can do this by using the general algorithm we propose in our Psychological Methods paper but it's not in the package.

Best,
Kosuke

Department of Politics
Princeton University
http://imai.princeton.edu

On Sep 8, 2012, at 11:54 AM, Yu-Chuen Huang wrote:

> Dear Professor Imai,
> 
> Thank you for your great contribution on experimental design and mediation analysis (and your matching papers, too). Alos, thanks for your generosity of posting your papers / technical reports on your website. I benefit a lot from your papers, especially your R packages, very useful research tools. Sensitivity analysis function lets your software become outstanding than the others.   
> 
> May I consult you a question about multi-level mediation analysis? My research area is education evaluation. Could your mediate software run analysis for multilevel design? I am not sure if the approach is the same as single level mediation analysis when using your R software. Thank you for reading my question.
> 
> Sincerely yours, 
> Tim
